components.name: logging_setup
components.description: Configures logging once, for the entry point - the only place that configures it (ARCH059 - no basicConfig, handler or root level anywhere else); every module takes its own logger with logging.getLogger(__name__). Level from the config, one line per event on stderr - the cluster keeps it - with the run id and the run date, never a secret, a row or personal data; the tests put the logging back as it was after each test (a shared fixture of tests/conftest.py - later logs, Spark's too, must not write to a test's closed stream).

decisions.question: Where do the logs go and in which format - e.g. stderr, one line per event with time, level, component and message?
decisions.answer: stderr, one line per event: time, level, component, message
